notes.title: Patch v69 (April 24th)
notes.notes:
- UI improvements
- Multiple purchase available
- New Tournament Bracket 21 & 22 with new prizes
- Two new purchases included
- Increase cap level of infinite upgrades levels
- Added new hp bar when clicking on bosses

notes.title: Patch v69 (April 24)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41865914/f66ff01b71e8676908c18e879c33564373449397.jpg

Hey community! We're back in action after a little break, and we're more pumped than ever to bring you an update with some of the small things you've been asking for.

On April 24th, we'll be rolling out the update on all our platforms! Exciting new challenges await you!

QoL Improvements: 

 UI improvements
 Multiple purchase available
 New Tournament Bracket 21 & 22 with new prizes
 Two new purchases included 
 Increase cap level of infinite upgrades levels 
 Added new hp bar when clicking on bosses

notes.title: Patch v68 (February 25)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Minor bug fixes, server upgrades, and analytics improvements.

notes.title: Patch v67 (February 2)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Added logic to ensure your energy rewards from Resource Packs, Daily Bonus, and Video Ads never decrease as you reach higher waves.
 Fixed bug where Commando Bot's Tech I upgrade wasn't applying the bonus to Tech Damage correctly.
 Improvements to server connection and leaderboard reporting.

notes.title: Patch v66 (January 19)
notes.notes:
QoL Improvements:

 Added setting to disable enemy movement speed bonuses (because quicker enemies can be more efficient for farming).
 Added setting to disable resource hauler spawns (because they may cause more harm than good on your last few waves of a push)


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a rare bug that caused Tanks and Necros to become unkillable and untargetable.
 Fixed a bug with the range stat calculation in the My Stats menu.
 Various other minor bug and UI fixes.

notes.title: Patch v65 (January 16)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 More rebalancing of Resource Packs, Daily Play Bonus, and Active Play rewards.
 Updated several third party plugins and libraries.

notes.title: Patch v64 (January 13)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed Resource Pack, Daily Play Bonus, and Video Ad rewards for early-mid game players (the previous update’s nerf was not intended). It still may be lower than before, because it now scales off a percentage of your Resource Pack 1 values, which quickly scale up as you reach higher waves.

notes.title: Patch v63 (January 13)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Improved the scaling and rewards from Resource Packs, Daily Play Bonus, and Video Ads.


QoL Improvements:

 Added a slider in the settings menu to fine-tune your game speed settings for optimal performance.
 Added Tank and Necro kills to the current run stats menu.
 Added 1 more spell loadout slot.
 Added additional highlights to characters that are ready to evolve or upgrade.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug related to server connections, tank cooldowns, and offline progress.
 Several other minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

notes.title: Patch v62 (January 6)
notes.notes:
QoL Improvements:

 Added a decimal to the Power Source energy spell to explain you can eventually get 2 energy per kill with enough upgrades.
 Adjusted some colors in the My Stats menu.
 Added a check to make sure you are playing the same version of the game on all devices to prevent any potential data loss.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an occasional bug with server times and tank cooldowns.
 Fixed a few inconsistent range update calculations.

notes.title: Patch v61 (Jan. 4)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Improved some Limited Time Events to be even more rewarding.
 Changed name of the Treant King commander to Forest Father.


QoL Improvements:

 Added 3 more loadout slots.
 Additional stat per hour tracking in the My Stats menu.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where offline progress wasn't rewarding kill exp.
 Fixed bug where you can respec commander upgrade trees without the required amount of gems.
 Various other minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

notes.title: Commanders Update!
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Commanders! These giant beasts are the leaders of your team of monsters, and provide global bonuses to nearly every aspect of the game. They become available after wave 3500.
 

Changes:

 Slightly increased desert kill exp map perk.
 Slightly increased cards in new tower decks.
 Slightly increased repeat card bonus dps.
 Increased the max level of the "Battle Roar" spell.
 Slightly increased offline progress rewards.


QoL Improvements:

 Selected monsters are now more visible with a yellow highlight and more polished placement circles.
 Several improvements to the "My Stats" menu, including some newly tracked stats such resources per hour. Also improved the accuracy of certain tracked stats.


Bug Fixes:

 Several minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

notes.title: Update v59 (Dec 1)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Reworked premium tower card packs to actually be worthwhile by significantly increasing their contents.
 Slightly reduced cost scaling of Temp Prestige Boosts.
 Removed the xMax button from the Temp Prestige Boosts menu.


QoL Improvements:

 Added a better explanation of how offline progress is calculated in the FAQ.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a couple secret titles that broke from the previous update.

notes.title: Update v58 (Nov 28)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Added 10 more stars to obtain for most achievements.
 Added "Tank Cooldown" into the Prestige Temp Boosts pool.


Changes:

 Increased the max level of most Prestige Temp Boosts, but made their cost scale up more quickly. 
 Pets below tier 6 can now be upgraded past level 10 until they reach 100% master stats.


QoL Improvements:

 Clicking the boss rush button will always open the boss rush menu (rather than just deactivate boss rush if it was previously active).
 Made boss energy drops more bold and visible.
 Added a "Max" upgrade button to the Prestige Temp Boosts menu.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the "skill ready" circle in the bottom right placement on Desert.
 Various minor bug and UI fixes.

notes.title: Patch v55 (Nov 10)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Peasant mobs are no longer considered bosses for monster targeting and skill usage.
 The "Execute" skill no longer works on bosses.


QoL Improvements:

 Color coded the "Current Run Stats" menu for improved readability.
 The boss rush HUD button now informs you which type of rush is active.
 Renamed the Cyclops Giant and Cyclops Mage pets.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed issue where changing the name of loadouts wouldn't always save correctly.

notes.title: Minor Patch v53 (Nov 7)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an issue where Cyclops Mage's (tier 6 debuff pet) Mass Reset perk was not refreshing spell cooldowns correctly.


Miscellaneous:

 Upgraded the Unity development environment and several plugins and packages to their newest versions (this was a massive upgrade), which should help keep the game up to date with the latest development features, performance, and security standards.

notes.title: Update v52 (Oct 24)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Various new end-game upgrades to continually increase the enemy gold drop per wave passed in a run. This means that enemies will drop more gold on higher waves than on earlier waves. The "My Stats" menu will help break down the bonus gold you are receiving from these upgrades.
 Tier 6 pets (evolution level 30 required to use).


Changes:

 Significantly increased the gold drop bonus earned from evolving towers after evolution 20, making these hard-earned evolutions even more rewarding!
 Significantly increased the gold drop rewards from video ads (active play bonus), daily play claims, and gem resource packs.
 Created additional tournament brackets and adjusted the rewards and placements of the current brackets to better fit their player populations.


QoL Improvements:

 Added "Safe" or "Gamble" spawn options for the Tank Swordsman.


Bug Fixes:

 Countless minor unimportant bug fixes.

notes.title: Minor Patch (v50)
notes.notes:
QoL Improvements:

 Boss gold and exp texts appear in front of other texts and remain visible longer.


Bug Fixes:

 Gold Auras now stack correctly with pet Cyclops' Gold Farm perk.
 You can now activate video ads / active play bonus while the game is paused.
 Several other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v49 (September 30)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 The 2x Gold Drop and 10x Gold Drop procs now stack additively. If you proc both on an enemy, he will drop 12x gold (10x + 2x). Previously, the 10x gold drop overwrote the 2x gold drop, so landing both would still only give 10x gold drop.
 Gold Lust/Aura, Exp Boost/Aura, and Energy Source/Aura skills all stack additively now. Previously, the higher skill would overwrite the lower one, but now you can stack them for significantly larger gains. Check out some examples of this logic in the in-game FAQ.
 Tank Swordsman energy reward now increases for every 10 total tank kills.
 Changed the rotation order of video ad (active play bonus) rewards.
 Removed the 9999 level cap on some tournament upgrades.


QoL Improvements:

 Improved the selected tower upgrade menu to be more clear and informative.
 The video ad (active play bonus) button now displays a cooldown timer with a preview of the upcoming reward.
 Added vague hints for the secret leaderboard titles.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the "LEGEND" leaderboard title giving the wrong amount of bonus DPS.
 Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch v48 (August 31)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Improved boss rush feature with 3 different options to skip waves.
 Buffed "Energyholic" leaderboard title reward from +1 to +3 boss energy drop.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where a stunned + teleported enemy can run off the path.
 Various other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v47 - Challenge and Secret Leaderboard Titles! (Aug. 6)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 TONS of new Progress, Challenge, and Secret Leaderboard Titles to unlock! They also now provide incredibly powerful stat boosts! These are meant to be like end-game achievements to hunt down and grind towards.


Changes:

 Reduced some 9 and 10 star achievement requirements to be more feasible.


QoL Improvements:

 Moved the Leaderboard Icons and Titles menus into the easier-to-access Missions tab. 


Bug Fixes:

 Various minor bug fixes and UI improvements.

notes.title: Update v46 (July 25)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 New “Marketplace” map!
 New Combat Spell “Lethargy” to weaken and slow all enemies.
 New Event for -10% spell and skill cooldown times.


Changes:

 Created Tournament Bracket 15 for players over wave 7000.
 The cost of the Kill Exp upgrade in the Research menu now caps at 300k.
 The cost of research upgrades increases again after level 20,000.
 Lowered the prestiges Daily Mission requirement.
 Significantly increased energy earnings from Daily Play Bonus and Video Ad Rewards.


QoL Improvements:

 A “Play/Pause” button can now be toggled in the bottom left corner of the screen.
 Tower Loadouts now save all tower targeting options, including your selections for boss only skills, enemy targeting, focus bosses, skill support, and range adjustments.
 Added 2 extra tower loadout slots (for a total of 5).
 Updated UI to make it more clear when a tower is on the Skill Support setting.
 The “Research” upgrade menu now has x10, x100, and x1000 buttons for quicker upgrading.


Bug Fixes:

 The “Execute” skill no longer triggers on Skill Support.
 Fixed several UI display issues.

notes.title: Patch v45 (July 7)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where the auto-ban detector was occasionally triggering false-positives.


Misc:

 Updated the Unity Ads and Server packages to be in-line with new policy requirements. This may also reduce random crashes on some devices.

notes.title: Update v41 (June 24)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Peasant Mobs now spawn more quickly based on your game speed. Higher game speed means more spawns which means more gold!


QoL Improvements:

 Added 90 and 120 FPS support on Android/iOS.
 Total active tower gold and total active pet gold values are now displayed separately in the stats menu.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed issue where a few specific upgrades were costing more on Android/iOS than on Steam.
 Fixed issue where exp texts would sometimes not appear.
 Fixed a few unintended skill/perk combinations that were far too OP.
 Tons of other very minor bug and UI fixes.

notes.title: Update v38 (May 26)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Upgrades to increase pet kill count and perk trigger chance via the gem upgrades store.
 2x Pet Kills event.


Changes:

 Moved tower placements around on the Snowfall and Haunted Dungeon maps to improve their playability.
 Reduced Temp Prestige Boost reroll cost from 25 to 15 gems.


QoL Improvements:

 Added confirmation screens when paying gems to reroll Artifacts and Temp Prestige Boosts.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where you could reroll the same Temp Prestige Boost.
 Various other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v37 (May 17)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 The gold drop bonus gained from evolutions now scales up significantly quicker after evolution level 10, especially for higher rarity towers.
 Increased Artifact Gold Drop (%) from +1% to +3%.
 The max level of the Tourney menu Gold Drop (%) upgrade changed from 10 to 9999.
 The top-tier monster chance upgrades now affect the Divine card chance in the last 2 card packs (rather than the mid-tier upgrades). This makes the top-tier upgrades much more valuable and less misleading.
 Temp Prestige Boosts are now rerolled individually, rather than having to do all three at once.
 Slightly reduced the "Time Played" daily mission requirements. 


QoL Improvements:

 Added CPU Saving Mode to Steam.
 Settings to individually filter damage, gold, exp, and skill texts.
 Improved performance and reduced file size.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed issue where pet upgrade notifications weren't appearing at the correct times.
 Fixed issue where monster skills weren't triggering correctly if his pet stole the kill.
 Various other minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Update v35 (May 6)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Limited Time Events! These events will be randomly activated for either a single weekday or an entire weekend. It will grant a random bonus such as double Kill Exp, Energy Drop, Daily Mission Gems, etc. for all players while the event is active. 
 An HP Reduction upgrade is now available in the Tank Swordsman and Necromancer menus.


Changes:

 Increased the Razor Bot pet's splash perk to a 2% trigger chance.
 Slightly lowered the last 2 star requirements for the tower levels achievement.
 Increased the DPS map perk on Snowfall from 10% to 15%.
 Increased both the Skill Cooldown and Spell Cooldown map perks on Haunted Dungeon from 5% to 10%.


QoL Improvements:

 Perk texts are a different color and appear in front of exp texts to be easier to see when triggered.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed a critical bug where having over 100% crit chance increased your crit damage by far too much. Every 1% over 100% crit chance should grant a bonus +5% crit damage.

notes.title: Patch v34 (May 3)
notes.notes: The previous update (v33) incorrectly removed some of the kills you earned with Pets. This patch restores those kills. You may notice your pet levels or kill counts have increased with this patch.

notes.title: Update v33 (April 29)
notes.notes:
Changes:

 Pet kills and levels are now universal across all monsters, rather than specific to a single monster. This should make them more convenient to use and level up. However, their kill count level requirements increased by about 20%.
 Improved Cyclops’ Gold Farm perk to include all gold boosting skills, spells, ads, etc. in the calculation for how much gold you earn per attack.
 Improved Butterfly’s Exp Share perk to give exp for all enemies killed within range, regardless of who gets the kill. 
 Pet damage is now included in the Rain of Fire spell damage.
 Pet kill counts do not increase on repeat waves.
 Monsters gain bonus critical hit damage when having over 100% critical hit chance.


QoL Improvements:

 Improved pet FAQ and moved it right inside the actual Pets menu.
 A manual save button can be found in the Settings menu for those of you who often lose data when exiting the game.


Bug Fixes:

 Minimized loadout menu settings save through game restarts.
 The Active Tower Gold value in the stats menu now includes pet gold drops.
 Several fixes related to advertisements, in-app purchases, and iOS crashes.

notes.title: Pets Update!
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Pets! These cute little creatures can be assigned to a monster for a variety of bonuses. They can attack, provide a gold drop bonus, and use a variety of unique perks (skills) to improve your monsters. This adds a totally new layer of strategy and decisions to the game, and should help speed up your progress and boost your max wave.
 New achievement for total pets unlocked.
 New daily mission for pet perks triggered.
 A few new and improved "Showoff" leaderboard titles.


Changes:

 Significantly increased offline progress speed.
 Adjusted the PvP Tournament brackets and rewards. Most rewards increased, and end-game bracket requirements decreased.


QoL Improvements:

 Improved the Loadouts menu to be more informative and show exactly where your monsters and pets are positioned on each map.


Bug Fixes:

 Too many minor bug fixes and UI adjustments to list.

notes.title: Update v30 (March 17)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 Added a Prestige Points III artifact (Tier 5) for +75% prestige points.


Changes:

 Increased offline progress speed.
 All DPS, Gold Drop, Kill Exp, and Prestige Point artifacts below Tier 5 now have a max level of 10. This ensures you stop receiving these less-valuable artifacts as you get further into the game, and only receive their higher tier variants instead.
 Added +50% prestige points into the Jackpot Artifact (Tier 5).
 Removed the max level cap of Kill Exp in the Tournament Upgrades menu.
 Increased area of effect of nearby enemies affected by the Slow skill.
 Increased area of effect of nearby enemies affected by the Weaken skill.
 Replaced the "Total Prestiges" leaderboard with a "Total Evolutions" leaderboard.


QoL Improvements:

 Range Sliders - control your monster's max range with this setting in the Targeting Options menu to avoid them stealing kills at undesirable times. 
 Volume Sliders - control how loud the music and sound effects play.
 Custom FPS Settings - You can now control the frames per second (FPS) that your game runs in.
 Most menus now auto-refresh, rather than forcing you to close and reopen it.
 Tapping the main menu button at the bottom of the screen will close that menu if it is already open.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed bug where towers would sometimes get stuck off a placement circle while dragging and dropping.
 Fixed bug where the "ready to evolve" particles would not move with the tower when dragging and dropping to a new placement.
 Fixed bug where the wrong notification text would appear when unlocking the "Perfect Tank" title.
 Fixed bug where your game speed would not update right away after evolving a monster with a game speed effecting skill.
 Fixed the Poison skill dealing damage even when the monster is on Skill Support.

notes.title: Major QoL Update (v27) (March 1)
notes.notes:
New Content:

 "Showoff" leaderboard titles that are unlocked by completing difficult challenges. They are only meant for fun customization and have no bonuses attached to them.


Changes:

 Increased the DPS bonus from evolutions on rarer monsters (+25% extra DPS attribute per higher rarity). This is meant to encourage evolving rarer monsters as you unlock them, rather than always sticking with the early game monsters.
 Increased energy cost of evolutions at higher evolution levels and for rarer monsters.
 Reduced cost scaling of dps, gold drop, and kill exp in the prestige menu, especially at higher levels.
 Added a 9th daily mission for 25 gems.
 Increased video ad gems reward from 3 to 5.
 Reduced temp prestige boost reroll cost from 50 to 25 gems.


QoL Improvements:

 You can now drag and drop monsters on the map to quickly move/swap them to other placements (finally, I know!).
 Double tap a monster on the map to quickly open its details menu.
 Added the monster type, evolution level, and gold drop bonus for each monster to the main monster list menu.
 If the Energy Source skill has a decimal value due to evolution skill power, show the decimal value with (rounded to x) next to it for clarity.
 The loadout button, spell buttons, and video ad button that were previously covered when a selected monster's upgrade menu is active, now move up to remain visible.
 Tons of other minor color changes and UI adjustments.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed daily mission requirements incorrectly scaling up in the middle of the day when they are meant to remain static.
 Fixed incorrect prestige points value in the Stats menu.
 Countless other minor bug fixes.
